Sector semis vehicles ruled out by price: SOXL 147.78, TECL 219.73, USD 96.11. ROOT CAUSE OF THE LOSS IS ENTRY TIMING, NOT THE EXIT. FNGU opened at 32.750 and topped at 34.000; Gate 1's mandatory 15-minute wait consumed +2.60pp of a +3.82pp move, so I bought the last quarter of it. At entry the instrument was already +4.38% on the day against a median MFE of 2.405% - 1.82x its typical whole-day excursion already spent - making the +4.81% target arithmetically unreachable rather than merely unlikely. True MFE was +1.19% and the +2.30% breakeven trigger never fired, so the ratchet never engaged and no gain was ever protected; nothing in the system banks a sub-1% move, correctly. Best checkpoint exit was +0.863% at 10:42 vs the actual -0.059%, so staying too long cost ~0.29R against entry timing's ~3pp. The ladder still saved ~0.98R against letting the -3.21% stop take a full R.
